asked.item: Will an Instagram post through Blotato show on Facebook automatically?
Will people see it twice if I also pick Facebook?

verdict.reason: The FAQ sentences say Blotato's Instagram publisher submits only to Instagram, and they explain how to post to both and avoid duplicates.

steps.text: Don't assume an Instagram-only post also published to Facebook, because Blotato's Instagram publisher submits to Instagram.
Instagram's native sharing behavior is separate from Blotato's destination results.
If you want both destinations, connect Instagram and the intended Facebook Page, then select both in Blotato and verify each result.
If Instagram's native crossposting is enabled, check Facebook before sending an additional Facebook post to avoid duplicates.
